title: The Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013

Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Women and Child Development Department Enforcement Date: 09-12-2013 Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra Notification: 9th December, 2013, vide notification No. S.O. 3606(E), dated 9th December, 2013, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii).
